answer: A stake-slashing collateral protocol curbs Sybil attacks by requiring agents to deposit economic bonds into an umber vault. During validation rounds orchestrated by a comet consensus engine, participants convene at an epoch summit to verify that each identity maintains active collateral. To forge multiple identities, an adversary must commit scarce financial liquidity per instance, risking total slashing upon misbehavior. However, this design favors wealthy entities and excludes capital-constrained agents.
